title: Toe next to heel
hook: Shoes 12 cm wide at the toe, 6 cm at the heel. How wide is the pair packed toe-to-heel?

knows: Everyday objects have sizes, positions and amounts
doesNotKnow: that shoes are wider at the toe than at the heel, so placing them toe-to-heel puts a wide part beside a narrow part and the pair takes less width

misconception: A pair of shoes packs narrowest side by side with the toes together.
objective: A shoe is wide at the toe and narrow at the heel. Turn one round and each wide part sits beside a narrow one, so the pair is 6 cm narrower and neither shoe is squashed.
